title: INQUIRE ASSOCIATION(EIBTASKN) origin data (ODAPPLID, ODUSERID, ODFACILNAME, ODNETWORKID, ODFACILTYPE as a CVDA), DELETEQ TS (the whole queue and its NEXT position, QIDERR, INVREQ for a name of binary zeros), RECEIVE MAP ... TERMINAL

scenarios.summary: INQUIRE ASSOCIATION(EIBTASKN) with all five origin options (RESP / RESP2), then with two of them: the stated origin, ODFACILTYPE as the CVDA 213
DELETEQ TS removes the queue with its items and NEXT position (QIDERR afterwards, and for a second delete); a queue written anew starts at item 1; a name of binary zeros is INVREQ
SEND MAP, then RECEIVE MAP ... TERMINAL ASIS: the input of the terminal that started the task
